reason: The no-guilt reflow pitch actually speaks to me, but nothing here says keyboard shortcuts, integrations or automations, and I'm not moving off Apple Notes for another closed planner. I might poke at the free plan, but I wouldn't pay $12 based on this.
objection: It wants to be my notes, contacts and email too, and I have no idea if it plugs into my Google Calendar, Slack, Linear or GitHub, or if it has a command palette. Every all-in-one I've tried ends up being a walled garden I abandon after two weeks.
would_change_my_mind: A keyboard-first command palette plus solid two-way sync with Google Calendar and my work tools (Slack, Linear, GitHub), shown in the first screen
